mu_name_from: Devil Square's object slot 5, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123); World10/Object10 serves all four squares, and squares 5-7 too (MapManager.cpp:1178-1181).
sheet_from: Data/Object10/, from MuMain, decoded under a ds_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool.
why_this_one: A broken stone block, dressed on its faces and rough where it split: rubble. docs/worlds/devil-square-port.md, Part B section 1.2.
material_note: Read off the art: bacc00 is dark green-grey dressed blocks laid in courses with mortar joints, laid stone: flagstone; bacc01 is rough pale broken stone with no joints: rock.
